# Print Production Lab
Commercial print, prepress, paper and binding calculator site. Results are transparent estimates and must be confirmed against job specifications.

Reprographics and plan-printing workflow:
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/reprographics-planning.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/drawing-scale-converter.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/plan-print-scaling-calculator.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/plot-sheet-fit-planner.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/printed-scale-verification.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/plan-tiling-calculator.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/guides/printing-plans-to-scale.html

Web tension and winding workflow:
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/web-tension-winding.html

- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/winding-torque-calculator.html

- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/dancer-pressure-calculator.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/winder-acceleration-torque.html
- https://printproductionlab.com/guides/web-tension-winding-setup.html

## Data Merge Production Prep
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/data-merge-production.html — local source-preparation workflow, not PDF rendering.
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/data-merge-csv-preflight.html — Check InDesign data-merge CSV headers, record structure, required fields, duplicate IDs and leading-zero risks locally before production.
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/cut-stack-csv-sequencer.html — Reorder complete CSV records into cut-and-stack sheet rows, with n-up cells, partial lifts, blank-cell accounting and a downloadable production map.
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/data-merge-image-matcher.html — Compare CSV image references with a local image folder or filename manifest; report missing, ambiguous, case-only and unused paths by record.
- https://printproductionlab.com/tools/variable-text-fit-checker.html — Screen CSV text against print frame dimensions in mm and font/leading in pt, using a local font and record-level overflow estimates without uploading data.
- https://printproductionlab.com/guides/data-merge-production-preflight.html — source-to-release checklist and worked cut-stack proof.
